_source: Half-year EPS read from each company's own interim results announcement on HKEXnews. A PROPOSAL, not page data: interim.json wants rev + nic + eps together and check-interim.js rightly refuses a period filed half-empty, so nothing here is merged automatically. Every entry carries the prior-year half printed alongside it in the same document, and was only written because that prior figure reconciled against the filed full year already in earnings.json — which is what proves the parser found the right line, read the right units, and had the two columns the right way round.
